description: A single full-circle progress ring with a percentage and caption centered inside.
overview: A single full-circle progress ring with a percentage and caption centered inside. Use it for one headline ratio, such as storage used or a completion rate.
usage: Set the value in `chartData` and keep the `domain` on `PolarAngleAxis` at your maximum. Update the percentage and caption in the center overlay, and change the color in `chartConfig`.
notes: The center text is hard-coded, not computed from the data, and there is no tooltip.
